title: EssentiallyOptimal Lite
description: Basically, behaves like vanilla Minecraft but without all the bugs and lag.
body:
![Available for Fabric](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98012646f2ef3e3b885317e694fbbc38b599252c_0.webp)

Support for non-fabric modloaders may come.

(Credit to wsrv.nl for the images above.)

![Information](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34089bf1cf241db05f1b22886357e0b5b3e201b1.png)

EssentiallyOptimal Lite is basically just a modpack that logicwise behaves like vanilla, but makes it faster. In testing, I got 144 FPS from letting the game run on it's own. That includes the logic of naturally spawning entities and items as well as the fluids.

![Technical](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d1d2792198a9dbbbb34215d3472815e62635f2c.png)

For better FPS, go to video settings and slide "Max FPS" to unlimited.

![Legal and revenue](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c5c8c3285616a892ee0f1cdffa59ea13dbc632f.png)

EssentiallyOptimal Lite is liscenced under the MIT Liscense, which can be reviewed [here.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MIT_License#:~:text=year%3E%20%3Ccopyright%20holders%3E-,Permission%20is%20hereby%20granted%2C%20free%20of%20charge%2C%20to%20any%20person%20obtaining,THE%20SOFTWARE%20OR%20THE%20USE%20OR%20OTHER%20DEALINGS%20IN%20THE%20SOFTWARE.,-Variations%5Bedit)

If you wish to support me, you do not have to donate, just Downloading will help.
